title: IDKMesh API Error Envelope v0.1
description: The standard error envelope every IDKMesh JSON API returns, per docs/specifications/API_CONVENTIONS_V0_1.md section 5. `code` is the compatibility-sensitive machine identifier; `message` is explanatory only and is never a parsing contract. A provider/worker domain failure is not automatically mapped to this shape as an HTTP 5xx -- that mapping is owned by the endpoint's own domain specification.

api_version.description: The URL compatibility version this response was served under, e.g. "v1". Independent of schema_version -- see section 1.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code. This is the compatibility contract; message text may change freely.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Never parsed by a compliant client.

retryable.description: Whether an identical retry of the same request could plausibly succeed without caller changes.

details.description: Bounded structured recovery information. Must never contain secrets, tokens, prompts, or private raw payloads (section 18).
